name: NanoClaw
description: NanoClaw is a self-hosted AI assistant that runs each agent in an isolated container and connects it to WhatsApp, Telegram, Slack, Discord, Matrix, Gmail, Mattermost and a local CLI. This script installs the latest NanoClaw release natively with Node.js and Docker in the home folder of a dedicated account in an unprivileged Debian LXC and hands over to NanoClaw's own setup wizard.

notes.text: NanoClaw runs natively, but its agents and the OneCLI credential gateway run in Docker inside the LXC, so nesting and keyctl are enabled. Interactive installs offer to start NanoClaw's setup wizard as the nanoclaw user at the end; declining, timing out or running unattended leaves setup for later, and the helper prints the command to resume it from the Proxmox host.

There is no web interface. NanoClaw is configured through its setup wizard and the ncl CLI in /home/nanoclaw/nanoclaw; the wizard registers provider credentials, builds the agent image and installs a systemd user service for the nanoclaw account.

The update function stages and validates a new release through NanoClaw's own transactional updater before it stops the service, rebuilds and restarts. A release with breaking changes that need manual migration steps is left untouched; finish it with /update-nanoclaw from a coding agent in /home/nanoclaw/nanoclaw.
Set var_nanoclaw_ref=main to install NanoClaw's main branch instead of the latest release. The update function then follows upstream main through the same staged updater.

The nanoclaw account owns /home/nanoclaw/nanoclaw and belongs to the docker group, which is root-equivalent inside the LXC. It has no password; reach it with 'pct enter <CTID>' and 'machinectl shell nanoclaw@'.
